component.name: Flicker
component.summary: Rufus-style USB bootable drive creator for Linux

description.p: Flicker is a fast, safe USB bootable drive creator for Linux written in Rust with a Material Design 3 Expressive interface.

ul.li: Create bootable USB drives from Linux hybrid ISOs, Windows 10/11 ISOs, and compressed raw images (.gz, .xz, .zst)
Format USB drives cleanly (GPT/MBR + FAT32, NTFS, exFAT, ext4)
Real post-write verification with OS page-cache invalidation
Unprivileged Wayland-friendly GUI with pkexec elevation only for write/format operations
